standard: BDS DD walls, layer-free v0 (MA-2a) — DRAFT

rules.why: DD (MA-2a): an outside wall whose build-up names stone is the office's stone-clad external wall at the wall type's width.
DD (MA-2a): an inside wall whose build-up names gypsum is the office's gypsum partition at the wall type's width.
DD (MA-2a): an outside wall — one side looks out of the storey's outline — is the office's external CMU at the wall type's width.
DD (MA-2a): an inside wall — both sides within the storey's outline — is the office's internal CMU at the wall type's width.
DD (MA-0): where the outer boundary cannot be read, a wall whose type's Function is Exterior is the external CMU at the wall type's width.
DD (MA-0): where the outer boundary cannot be read, a wall whose type's Function is Interior is the gypsum partition at the wall type's width.
